title: Conditionals: The Fork
description: Teach the machine to think. Use if, elif, and else to create programs that react differently to different situations.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Indentation
exercises.description: What is the purpose of indentation in Python?
options: It defines a block of code (scope)
It makes the code run faster

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Else Logic
exercises.description: When does the code inside an `else` block execute?

exercises.title: Neural Sync: If Statement
exercises.targetCode:
if power_level > 9000:
    print("Warning: Power level critical! Over 9000!")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Else Block
exercises.targetCode:
else:
    print("Access Denied. Security protocol engaged. Lockdown initiated.")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Elif Chain
exercises.description: Add a secondary check for admin.
exercises.targetCode:
elif user_role == "admin":
    print("Welcome, Administrator. Full access granted.")

exercises.title: System Repair: Indentation Error
exercises.description: The print statement isn't part of the if block because it's not indented.

exercises.title: System Repair: Colon Syntax
exercises.description: Something crucial is missing at the end of the if line.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Access Gate
exercises.description: Take password input. If it is 'open', print 'Welcome'. Else, print 'Locked'.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Traffic Light
exercises.description: Take input 'color'. If 'red' -> Stop. If 'green' -> Go. Else -> Caution.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Positive/Negative
exercises.description: Take integer input. Print 'Pos' if > 0, 'Neg' if < 0, else 'Zero'.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Threat Level Assessment
exercises.description: Security system with 3 threat levels using elif chain.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Multi-Level Clearance System
exercises.description: Professional clearance protocol with 4 security levels and comments.

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Missing Elif Colon
exercises.description: SYNTAX ERROR: Security checkpoint failing! Missing colon after elif condition causes system crash!

if score >= 90:
    print('A')
elif score >= 80
    print('B')

exercises.title: Access Control: Rank-Based Permissions
exercises.description: Input operative rank (1-4). Print permissions: 1='Field Agent', 2='Senior Agent', 3='Team Lead', 4='Director'. Use elif!

exercises.title: Mission Priority: Urgency Classifier
exercises.description: Input mission urgency (1-5). 5='CRITICAL', 4='HIGH', 3='MEDIUM', 2='LOW', 1='ROUTINE'. Print urgency level.

exercises.title: Enemy Intel: Threat Assessment
exercises.description: Input enemy count. <10='Minimal', 10-50='Moderate', 51-100='Severe', >100='Critical'. Use elif with ranges!

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Operative Evaluation System
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Rate operative performance. Input score (0-100). 90+='Elite', 75-89='Excellent', 60-74='Competent', 50-59='Acceptable', <50='Reassignment Required'. Complex elif chain!
